cities.name: Monaco
cities.local_food_tip: Mediterranean meals like salads, pasta, veggie dishes, soups, fresh bread, pastries i lagani morski ukusi — jednostavno, lagano i vrlo kvalitetno.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Monaco-Ville (Old Town) walk: small alleys, pastel buildings, calm morning atmosphere. → 🏛️ Prince’s Palace (Exterior viewpoint only). → 🌊 Saint-Martin Gardens: sea cliffs + greenery. → ☕ Old-town café.

Afternoon: 🚤 Port Hercules harbor walk: yachts, palm trees, open promenades. → 🍽️ Light Mediterranean lunch (soups, pasta, salads). → 🏙️ Monte Carlo district (Exterior): elegant boulevards + modern corners. → 🌿 Japanese Garden.

Sunset: 🌅 Larvotto Beach promenade: golden reflections on the water.

Night: 🌃 Seaside dessert cafés + peaceful harbor lights.
public_transport_tips: 🚌 Use Monaco Bus Company lines for fast movement between districts.
🚶 The whole city is walkable with elevators/lifts helping uphill routes.
📱 Use 'Monaco Bus' app for maps & schedules.
